# Annotated version tags with NO CHANGELOG.md entry, grandfathered.
#
# Read by scripts/check-changelog-full-history.py (guard G2-EXT).
#
# G2 (version-consistency.yml) already requires a CHANGELOG.md entry for every
# annotated tag from v11.0.0 up, and scopes itself there on purpose: pre-v11
# tags predate the CHANGELOG-on-tag discipline entirely, and CHANGELOG.md has
# no coverage for that era at all (verified 2026-09-28 via
# `git for-each-ref --format='%(refname:short) %(objecttype)' refs/tags`,
# filtered to objecttype=tag i.e. ANNOTATED only, matched against the same
# "## [vX.Y.Z]" / "## vX.Y.Z" header G2 checks): every one of these 40
# annotated pre-v11 tags has zero matching header. Many pre-v11 vX.Y.Z-looking
# refs are LIGHTWEIGHT tags (git cat-file -t == commit, not tag) and are
# correctly invisible to this guard already, exactly like G2/G4 — only the
# ANNOTATED ones are listed here.
#
# G2-EXT closes the gap ABOVE this ledger: it walks every annotated tag in the
# whole repo, not just v11+, so any NEW gap anywhere in history (a tag pushed
# without a CHANGELOG entry, at any version) is caught going forward. Only the
# 40 tags below — the pre-v11 backlog that predates the guard by construction
# — are exempt.
#
# ENFORCED IN BOTH DIRECTIONS, exactly like .github/known-orphan-tags.txt and
# .github/known-untagged-releases.txt:
#   * a tag missing its CHANGELOG entry that is NOT listed here fails the
#     build (catches regressions, at any version, not just v11+);
#   * a listed tag that NOW has a matching CHANGELOG entry ALSO fails the
#     build, so this list is forced to shrink as debt is repaid and can never
#     rot into a blanket exemption that swallows the next real gap.
#
# DO NOT ADD A LINE HERE TO MAKE A RED CHECK GO AWAY. A red G2-EXT on a v11+
# tag means G2 itself is already failing too — fix the CHANGELOG, don't
# grandfather it. This ledger is for the pre-v11 backlog only.
v0.1.12  # pre-v11, predates G2 (CHANGELOG gate); no commit ever carried a matching entry
